messages:
Jordan: Planning to land #509 (SDK migration + examples) in the 15:00 docs slot. Netlify preview error on artifact shard. Can we still get approvals?
Leah: If it's just big assets causing EBUSY, I'll swap to lightweight fallbacks and push. That should unblock the preview.
Marcus: ci-bot shows: 
ci-bot: Build failed for branch docs/sdk-migration-509 — Error: EBUSY writing artifact shard 7. Retrying...
Yara: Two paths: revert heavy assets now and merge, or replace with optimized ones and wait for a clean preview. Which is faster?
Jordan: Leah, can you try optimized assets? If preview still fails, we'll do content-only merge.
Leah: On it. Replacing SVGs with PNG fallbacks and updating alt text. Pushing in ~7m.
Marcus: Doing a short content pass. Adding a token-caching CLI example and fixing heading levels.
Jordan: Reminder: run `mkdocs build` locally to check site_url-linked references before merge.
Leah: Local check command I used:
```
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
```
Preview serves; API refs need site_url to match production.
ci-bot: New deploy attempt: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1948765701 (in progress). Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1948765701#logs
Leah: Push complete. Should rebuild quickly.
Marcus: Approved for content after adding the CLI snippet and fixing a broken anchor.
Yara: If Netlify succeeds before 15:10 we merge. If not, maintainers can force-merge with `merge: maintainer` and `docs: force-merge` note. Only do that if CI can't recover.
ci-bot: Deploy 1948765701 succeeded: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1948765701
Jordan: Merging now. Include `docs-release` tag in commit.
Leah: I'll follow up with a PR to reintroduce optimized inline SVGs and add a CDN caching note.
Marcus: Quick post-merge check: verify live site has no 404s for API links.
Jordan: Merged at 15:04. Closing thread.
